column1: # Struct layouts for WARBREED.EXE. Applied by tools/ghidra/ApplyNames.java (see re/ghidra.md).
# Struct <TAB> size <TAB> 0xSIZE                      object size (e.g. from operator new before the ctor)
# Struct <TAB> base <TAB> BaseStruct                  flatten BaseStruct's fields in first
# Class_vftable <TAB> 0xSLOT <TAB> ctype <TAB> name   names a vtable slot (field of the generated vtable struct)
# - An RTTI class's struct is rebuilt on every apply: vftable pointer(s), then its primary base class's
#   fields (so SGame shows Scene's), then the lines below. Offsets are from the object start; the
#   vftable pointer at +0 is generated, so lines at +0 of a polymorphic class are ignored.
# - ctype: char, short, int, long, unsigned ..., byte, word, dword, float, bool, void, a struct or
#   class name, or a Windows SDK type (RECT, HWND...), with '*' and [N]: "Scene *[4]", "short[4]".
# - Notes start with H/M/L (see names.tsv). "(also: ...)" records another source's reading.
